text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Alright...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Heh, not bad.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I could leave anyone in the dust...
...Hey, Casino.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Oh?
Is something the matter?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Run with me right now. 2000m on dirt.
Same conditions as the BC Classic. You down?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Hm.
Okay, that's fine with me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAAAAH......!!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Just as I thought, I'm in top shape today.
At this rate, it'll be a breeze—)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(Heh... As expected, she harbors immense talent.
Enough to make me look forward to the Breeders' Cup. But still—)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: I'm way better than you...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Haaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Phew!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh!
Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Wonderful.
If we can draw out all of your potential,
you'll definitely be able to contend for the win at the actual BC.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haa...?! Stop messing with me!
Is that supposed to be consolation? Face me again right now!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Sure.
I don't mind."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Oryaah!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...*Pant*... *pant*... damn it...!
Tomorrow... I will... definitely... win...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed.
If you wish to win the BC, you must become stronger than I was on that day, at the very least.
Right now, Espoir City sees Casino Drive—who shares similar aptitudes and finished ahead in the mock race—as her rival.

If we can capitalize on her fiery desire for a rematch,
we might be able to help her grow significantly.
choice_data_list: I'd love to help give them a hint for their growth.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
You can leave that part to me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (Why...? Our speeds shouldn't be barely any different...!)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —Here's a "tip" for you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Chips?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's a hint, a hint.
Just watch how I run once.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...What does that Casino think she's doing...
Her running style isn't even that different from—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—No way...!
Is that really how she's been running...!?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: (Her greatest asset is her acceleration from the early stages. Her ability to push full throttle right from the start.)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: (If she acquires the technique to make full use of it—flawless cornering—she's bound to do even better than me...!)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
With your legs, there should be a chance
to take the lead in the first half.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However, at the Breeders' Cup, cornering technique
matters even more than it does in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
If you have the skill to capitalize on an early lead, you can reduce the risk of being swallowed by the pack.
What I just showed you was a run meant for that.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...It's infuriating.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Infuriating?
My running just now?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: That's not what I mean. ...Why are you giving running tips to the person who's challenging you to a rematch?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What, giving me pity just 'cause you're wiping the floor with me? Are you... underestimating me?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, 'cause I'm gonna say it—
Nothing ticks me off more than people looking down on me...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Neither.
It's neither of those.
This is, so to speak, only natural.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Natural...?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, Umamusume athletes in America tend not to be obsessive about keeping their techniques secret.
It's not like the patent business, after all."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Now I get it even less.
If we get ripped off and lose, we'll look like total idiots!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. They don't think like that
in American sports, you know. And that's because—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: It's because she takes such pride in her own technique, knowing it can't be easily copied even if taught, you see.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—...!
So you're saying if I think I can copy it, I should just try...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. Whether the opponent is above or below
doesn't matter. It's purely pride in one's own craft."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: And besides, if they can evolve and advance the skills I pass on even beyond my own—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
If I master it next, I'll become even stronger.
That's why there's no need to hesitate.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: So that I... can become even stronger...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"I believe that mindset is... one of the factors
that made America a sporting powerhouse."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: This is the American mindset, and if you hesitate there, you will never win.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Personally, I'm expecting you to brush up on
the running style I taught you."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that—
I can use it as fuel to make myself stronger this time, right?"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, my meeting is coming right up.
I apologize, but I must take my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Aaargh, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...You're making it sound like
my whole mindset is wimping out.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll make Casino's way of running my own.
And then—next time, I'm definitely gonna win...!
—The next week.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ooooooooryaaaaaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Finally won...!
How's that, Casino...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Excellent!
Be sure not to forget that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Casino. Once I perfect this running style, I'm gonna get way stronger. And then—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
In America! At the BC!
I'm gonna show them the greatest run in the world!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If that happens, all sorts of Umamusume
will come rushing to learn how to run like the best in the world.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Heh. What a pain in the ass... but if you're really begging me that much, I'll think about it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Ah, in that case, I have a request of my own.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I want you to teach the rest of the team
that running technique you've mastered.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...To those guys?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course it's not mandatory.
Assuming you don't mind being imitated, that is.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Heh! Just kiddin'.
Like I'd ever wimp out now!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if someone can handle it better than me...
I just gotta learn that and get even stronger, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, punks!
I'll teach ya how to corner!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.
choice_data_list: This is... an outcome beyond expectations.
This is... an outcome beyond expectations.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed.
An unexpected incentive... as one might call it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I believe this experience will
brush up her—no, "DREAMS" as a whole.
